_readme: People and corrections that are NOT in the Ancestry export, merged over it by
tools/build-tree.py on every build. This is the file to edit as the research
turns up new people — data/tree.json is generated and anything typed into it
is destroyed on the next build.
Run `tools/build-tree.py --help-additions` for the full field list. In short:
an entry whose `id` already exists in the GEDCOM patches that person field by
field; an entry with a new id creates one. Everything touched here is tagged
`added: true` and draws in cyan on the diagram, so research-in-progress never
Links are not made symmetric for you. To attach a new person to the tree,
give them a `fams`/`famc` AND put them in that family's husband/wife/children.
Both arrays may be left empty. This file is optional — the build works fine
